verdict.rationale: Superset's evidence covers agent orchestration, worktree isolation, diff review before merge, and status/notification hooks (e.g. 'waiting for input'), but there is no mention of configurable autonomy tiers or permission levels that let an engineering-lead define what an agent can do unattended versus what requires confirmation. This is a fair axis for a multi-agent orchestration platform, but no feature resembling tiered autonomy controls is documented.
